BevRouteEvidenceV4.description:
Describe presentation properties of one prompt-visible BEV.

These fields are retained at the reusable observation boundary for VQA V2
compatibility.  Reasoning V4.6 never treats them as route-progress,
traversability, clearance, or collision-safety supervision.

Args:
    frame: Declared BEV presentation frame.
    ego_forward: Display direction corresponding to ego forward.
    route_overlay_visible: Whether a route overlay is rendered.
    route_direction_authority: Whether clear orientation may support a
        visible task direction.
    route_progress_authority: Legacy observation metadata ignored by
        Reasoning V4.6.
    route_terminal_marker_visible: Legacy presentation metadata ignored by
        Reasoning V4.6.
    route_endpoint_semantics: Legacy endpoint provenance ignored by
        Reasoning V4.6.
    local_safety_authority: Always false in Stage-A.
    producer_contract_id: Versioned upstream producer identity.
    producer_contract_version: Exact upstream producer version.
BevRouteEvidenceV4.title: BevRouteEvidenceV4

DirectionContextV4.description:
Select approved action and affordance-probe profiles.

Args:
    action_profile_id: Canonical fine action-profile identifier.
    action_profile_version: Exact action-profile version.
    affordance_probe_profile_id: Canonical probe identifier.
    affordance_probe_profile_version: Exact probe version.
DirectionContextV4.title: DirectionContextV4

DirectionSupervisionV4.description: Carry one complete deterministic direction label.
DirectionSupervisionV4.title: DirectionSupervisionV4

EvidenceCatalogEntryV4.description:
Describe one prompt-visible raw input item.

Args:
    ref: Stable input-envelope reference.
    modality: Input modality.
    summary: Optional prompt-visible summary.
    attributes: Prompt-visible producer metadata.
    bev_route_evidence: Optional BEV presentation declaration.
EvidenceCatalogEntryV4.title: EvidenceCatalogEntryV4

InputModalitiesV4.description:
Record which Stage-A inputs are present.

Args:
    fpv: Current FPV is mandatory.
    history_fpv: One or more history FPV images are input only.
    instruction: An instruction is visible.
    bev: A BEV image is visible.
    goal_image: A goal image is visible.
    pixel_goal: A pixel goal is visible.
    waypoint: A waypoint is visible.
InputModalitiesV4.title: InputModalitiesV4

StageIICFMTrainingViewV2.description:
Exchange one four-second CFM row under an explicit reasoning route.

V2 keeps the observation and accepted standalone Decision visible on both
routes.  The reasoning field is a discriminated union: either an accepted
Pass-R cache or a cryptographically linked Stage I dropout absence.  Query
count is deliberately not part of this data view because ms-swift owns the
independent ``Q`` profile while the target remains fixed at ``T=32``.
StageIICFMTrainingViewV2.title: StageIICFMTrainingViewV2

StageIICachedTrajQueryBindingV1.description:
Bind an existing ``[TRAJ_i]`` cache to a later action observation.

This is a timing contract only.  The query tensor and fast visual memory
remain ms-swift runtime tensors; no new semantic token is introduced.
StageIICachedTrajQueryBindingV1.title: StageIICachedTrajQueryBindingV1

StageIICachedTrajQueryObservationV1.description:
Model-visible observation used to produce one cached query state.

This record intentionally contains no trajectory target or private action
supervision. It is paired with a later action view by the training-view
contract below.
StageIICachedTrajQueryObservationV1.title: StageIICachedTrajQueryObservationV1

StageIIContextCacheV1.description:
Store one strict Pass-R or Pass-D result for an exact input projection.

Args:
    schema_version: Exact cache schema stamp.
    cache_id: Stable context-kind-specific cache identity.
    sample_id: Parent Stage I FullCoT sample identity.
    source_group_id: Parent source group.
    split_group_id: Leakage-safe split group.
    dataset_source: Dataset family.
    modality_profile_id: Exact projected modality combination.
    parent_source_fingerprint: Immutable parent source digest.
    projected_input_digest: Digest of every model-visible input.
    context_kind: Independent reasoning-grounding or Decision pass.
    section_names: Exact canonical section sequence.
    producer: Frozen model/prompt/parser/generation identity.
    raw_generation: Original output retained for audit only.
    canonical_text: Strict parsed text exposed to Pass T.
    parse_status: Accepted or rejected parser state.
    errors: Bounded parser error codes.
    cache_digest: SHA-256 over all other cache fields.
StageIIContextCacheV1.title: StageIIContextCacheV1

StageIIContextProducerV1.description:
Identify the exact producer of one cached reasoning context.

Args:
    source: Oracle or frozen-model provenance.
    base_model_id: Base LVLM identity.
    checkpoint_id: Exact Stage I checkpoint identity.
    checkpoint_digest: Immutable checkpoint digest.
    adapter_id: Optional adapter identity.
    prompt_profile_id: Pass-specific prompt profile.
    prompt_digest: Exact prompt-policy digest.
    parser_contract_id: Strict parser identity.
    parser_contract_digest: Exact parser-contract digest.
    generation_config: Frozen decoding configuration.
    generation_config_digest: SHA-256 of ``generation_config``.
StageIIContextProducerV1.title: StageIIContextProducerV1

StageIILossMaskV1.description:
Route one trajectory row exclusively to the System1 CFM objective.

Args:
    lm: Always false because Pass T has no assistant text.
    system1_action: Always true for the masked CFM objective.
    trajectory: Always false for the legacy pixel trajectory head.
    segmentation: Always false for the segmentation head.
StageIILossMaskV1.title: StageIILossMaskV1

StageIIReasoningAbsentV2.description:
Prove that reasoning is absent only because Stage I routed no-CoT.

No parser result is stored here.  Absence is valid only when it is linked
to a validated Stage I reasoning-dropout projection of an immutable
FullCoT parent.
StageIIReasoningAbsentV2.title: StageIIReasoningAbsentV2

StageIIReasoningPresentV2.description:
Bind V2 Pass T to one accepted reasoning-grounding cache.

The wrapper is intentionally distinct from an optional cache field.  Its
discriminator proves that reasoning is present and accepted; a rejected or
empty cache therefore cannot silently become a no-CoT example.
StageIIReasoningPresentV2.title: StageIIReasoningPresentV2

StageIITrajectoryPolicyV2.description:
Freeze the strict four-second metric trajectory data policy.

V2 is a data-only contract for the future decoupled latent-plan/CFM model.
It intentionally does not alter the executable V1 training view or its
16-query head.  Every accepted row contains the complete 4-second horizon;
suffix padding is forbidden. Source speed remains an audited statistic;
exceeding 6 m/s does not reject a row because speed alone cannot
distinguish real fast motion from source-specific sampling behavior.

Args:
    source_adapter_id: Versioned raw-pose adapter used for this dataset.
    trajectory_source: Dataset-owned odometry or pose provenance.
    raw_timestamp_unit: Unit of the raw pose clock before conversion.
    yaw_offset_deg: Fixed odom-to-base rotation used only for XY projection.

max_source_yaw_rate_rad_s.title: Max Source Yaw Rate Rad S

StageIITrajectoryPolicyV2.title: StageIITrajectoryPolicyV2

StageIITrajectoryTargetV2.description: Carry one complete 4-second, 32-step metric FLU target.
StageIITrajectoryTargetV2.title: StageIITrajectoryTargetV2

StageIModalityAvailabilityV1.description:
Record native optional-modality availability before training dropout.

Args:
    current_fpv: Current FPV is mandatory for every Stage I view.
    history_fpv: At least one history FPV image is native input.
    instruction: A prompt-visible instruction is native input.
    bev: A prompt-visible BEV image is native input.
    goal_image: A goal image exists but is unsupported in Stage I v1.
    pixel_goal: A pixel goal exists but is unsupported in Stage I v1.
    waypoint: A waypoint exists but is dormant in Stage I v1.
StageIModalityAvailabilityV1.title: StageIModalityAvailabilityV1

StageIModalitySelectionV1.description:
Record the optional modalities retained by one training view.

Args:
    current_fpv: Current FPV is always retained.
    history_fpv: Retain native history FPV images.
    instruction: Retain the native instruction.
    bev: Retain native BEV images.
    goal_image: Always false in Stage I v1.
    pixel_goal: Always false in Stage I v1.
    waypoint: Always false in Stage I v1.
StageIModalitySelectionV1.title: StageIModalitySelectionV1

StageIModalityStateV1.description:
Expose whether each optional modality is present, absent, or dropped.

Args:
    history_fpv: State of history FPV.
    instruction: State of the instruction.
    bev: State of BEV.
    goal_image: State of goal-image input.
    pixel_goal: State of pixel-goal input.
    waypoint: State of waypoint input.
StageIModalityStateV1.title: StageIModalityStateV1

StageIReasoningDropoutLinkV2.description: Bind a direct Decision row to its immutable FullCoT parent.
StageIReasoningDropoutLinkV2.title: StageIReasoningDropoutLinkV2
